phon.intro: 西安话（陕西方言·关中片）有声母 26 个（含零声母）、韵母 40 个、四声（阴平 21、阳平 24、上声 53、去声 44）。一个音节写作「声母 + 韵母 + 调号」，如 bfeng4 中、jyuen1 軍。下表例字沿用字表的繁体字形。
phon.initialsNote: z c s 只接 ɿ 和洪音韵母，细音一律 j q x；bf pf 只出现在合口／洪音前；r 只配 7 个洪音韵母；ng 只配洪音。
phon.finalsNote: an en ang eng 等是鼻化元音，不像普通话那样收 -n / -ng；uong / yuong 对应普通话的 ong / iong；撮呼一律带 y，声母后也不省（jyuen 軍、nyu 女）。
phon.tonesNote: 入声已并入这四调，归派与普通话不同：立 li1、白 bei2、藥 yuo1、六 liou1。

diff.p: b p m f d t n l g k h z c s zh ch sh r j q x 这些声母字母与读音跟普通话一致；a i u e er ai ei ao ou ia ie iao ian iang ua uo uai uan uang 这些韵母拼写也一致。零声母的 y / w 规则与普通话完全相同。

diff.h: ② 字母相同、音值不同
diff.p: 所有 -n / -ng 结尾的韵母在西安话里读鼻化元音：an = ã、en = ẽ、ang = ɑɣ̃、eng = əɣ̃。字母一样，念法不一样。

head: 普通话
西安话拼音
例
rows: 魚 yu2、月 yue1、元 yuan2、軍 jyuen1

diff.p: 声母：bf pf（豬 bfu1、窗 pfang1）、v（文 ven2）、ng（安 ngan1）。韵母：uu（胳 guu1）、o（只在 vo：若 vo1）、iai（皆 jiai1）、yuo（樂 yuo1）。

diff.h: ⑥ 调号位置一样、调值不同
diff.p: 普通话的 ā á ǎ à 对应本方案的 1 2 3 4，但西安话的调值是 21 / 24 / 53 / 44。母语者按本地调值念即可，不必换算。

phon.njIntro: 南郊音指西安南郊（高新、小寨、曲江一带）的口音。声母、韵母的格局属渭南型：声母 24 个（没有 bf、pf），韵母 38 个（没有 uu、iai）；声调与城区音相同，仍是四声。
phon.njInitialsNote: 比城区音少 bf、pf 两组：bf 改读 z（豬 bfu1→zu1），pf 改读 c（春 pfen1→cuen1），韵母同时增生 u 介音。
phon.njFinalsNote: 比城区音少 uu、iai 两类：uu 并入 e（圪 guu1→ge1），iai 并入 ie（階 jiai1→jie1）。
phon.njTonesNote: 声调与城区音一致：阴平 21、阳平 24、上声 53、去声 44，入声同样已派入四声。
phon.njDiffTitle: 城区音与南郊音的区别

aboutParas: 当代西安市以西安古城区为中心，按方位分为东郊、西郊、南郊、北郊。西安话属中原官话—关中片—东府方言：城区、北郊、西郊属西安型；南郊、东郊、长安区、临潼，乃至以东到渭南市境内，都属渭南型。
两型在平翘舌的分布、声母韵母的音值等方面都有若干区别。以往对西安话的描述多聚焦于城区方言，对当代西安市核心城区（高新—小寨—曲江一线）实际强势的南郊音反而关注较少。本站因此补上南郊音，与城区音并排给出。

phon.intro: The Xi’an dialect (Guanzhong, Shaanxi) has 26 initials (including zero initial), 40 finals and 4 tones (Yinping 21, Yangping 24, Shangsheng 53, Qusheng 44). A syllable is written as initial + final + tone digit, e.g. bfeng4 中, jyuen1 軍. Examples below keep the dictionary’s traditional glyphs.
phon.initialsNote: z c s occur only before ɿ and non-front finals; before i / y the series is j q x. bf pf occur only before rounded/back finals; r takes 7 back finals; ng takes back finals only.
phon.finalsNote: an en ang eng are nasalised vowels, not -n / -ng codas as in Mandarin; uong / yuong correspond to Mandarin ong / iong; the yu-series always keeps y, even after an initial (jyuen 軍, nyu 女).
phon.tonesNote: The old entering tone has merged into these four, differently from Mandarin: 立 li1, 白 bei2, 藥 yuo1, 六 liou1.

diff.p: The initial letters b p m f d t n l g k h z c s zh ch sh r j q x stand for the same sounds as in Mandarin; the finals a i u e er ai ei ao ou ia ie iao ian iang ua uo uai uan uang are spelled the same. The y / w rules for zero-initial syllables are exactly Mandarin’s.
Every final ending in -n / -ng is a nasalised vowel in Xi’an: an = ã, en = ẽ, ang = ɑɣ̃, eng = əɣ̃. The spelling matches, the pronunciation does not.

phon.njIntro: The southern-suburb variety (Gaoxin, Xiaozhai, Qujiang) follows the Weinan pattern in its initials and finals: 24 initials (no bf, pf) and 38 finals (no uu, iai). Its tones are the same four as the urban variety.
phon.njInitialsNote: Two groups fewer than the urban variety: bf becomes z (豬 bfu1→zu1), pf becomes c (春 pfen1→cuen1), and the final gains a u medial.
phon.njFinalsNote: Two classes fewer than the urban variety: uu merges into e (圪 guu1→ge1), iai into ie (階 jiai1→jie1).
phon.njTonesNote: Same tones as the urban variety: Yinping 21, Yangping 24, Shangsheng 53, Qusheng 44; the entering tone has likewise split into these four.
phon.njNote: 3,578 southern readings in all: 2,979 characters identical to the urban variety, 366 different.

aboutParas: Contemporary Xi'an is centred on the old walled city and divided by direction into the eastern, western, southern and northern suburbs. Xi'an speech belongs to Central Plains Mandarin – Guanzhong group – Dongfu dialect: the city centre, the northern and the western suburbs speak the Xi'an type; the southern and eastern suburbs, Chang'an district, Lintong and the land eastward into Weinan all speak the Weinan type.

The two types differ in the distribution of retroflex and dental sibilants and in the phonetic values of initials and finals. Earlier descriptions of Xi'an speech centred on the city proper and paid little attention to the southern-suburb variety, which is in fact the dominant accent in the core districts of Gaoxin, Xiaozhai and Qujiang. This site therefore adds it alongside the urban readings.
en.aboutCap: Schematic accent map of Xi'an (the city area is inside the Ming wall; not administrative boundaries)
en.aboutNote: The southern-suburb readings are established from the urban Xi'an readings, the Weinan readings, and the speech of the site's author and relatives. They are offered for reference only; corrections are most welcome.

ja.aboutTitle: 西安のアクセント分区
aboutParas: 現在の西安は西安古城を中心に、方位によって東郊・西郊・南郊・北郊に分けられます。西安方言は中原官話—関中片—東府方言に属します。城区・北郊・西郊は西安型、南郊・東郊・長安区・臨潼、さらに東の渭南市域にかけては渭南型です。
両型はそり舌音と歯茎音の分布、声母・韻母の音価などにいくつかの違いがあります。従来の西安方言の記述は城区に偏り、現代西安の中核市街（高新—小寨—曲江一帯）で実際に優勢な南郊音はあまり顧みられてきませんでした。そこで当サイトは南郊音を加え、城区音と並べて示します。
ja.aboutCap: 西安のアクセント分区（城区は明城壁の内側、行政界ではありません）
ja.aboutNote: 南郊音は西安城区音、渭南音、そして作者本人と親族の発音をもとに定めたもので、参考程度にご覧ください。誤りがあればご指摘いただければ幸いです。
